title: Planning the eco-club garden
body: A school eco-club is planning a rectangular vegetable garden. The members want the length of the garden to be 5 metres more than its breadth, and the area to be exactly 84 square metres. Taking the breadth as x metres, they write x(x + 5) = 84, that is, x² + 5x − 84 = 0. To factorise the left side, they look for two numbers whose sum is 5 and whose product is −84. To make a model of a garden bed for the school exhibition, Meena takes one x²-tile, nine x-tiles (each x units by 1 unit) and twenty unit tiles, and arranges all of them, without overlapping, to form a single rectangle.
